old_problem: The historical review correctly recognized full-repository erasure as destructive but treated command semantics, erased scope and recovery as one unresolved block. IPMI 2.0 section 33.16 defines the standard IB command, exact all-record scope, reservation, CLR confirmation field and start/status state machine; section 33.13 defines whole-record Add SDR reconstruction. Project-specific BMC identity, update modality and an independently proven reconstruction artifact can therefore be fail-closed runtime prerequisites rather than invented command semantics.
disposition_reason: Define the case as one explicitly authorized in-band Storage 0Ah/27h clear on an isolated non-production target, followed by bounded status-only polling, proof of a zero-record repository and immediate reconstruction from a prevalidated complete package. Execution is NOT READY until a matching-model/firmware rehearsal has proven that every baseline record can be recreated without another clear and that sensor, threshold, event, inventory and control semantics return. The start request may be sent once only; a timeout or ambiguous response is investigated by status and repository reads, never by repeating AAh. Generic log clearing, individual Delete, OOB evidence, blind ipmitool fill, production targets and an untested export are prohibited.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1086-1088, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, tests_gpt_merged, manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code occurs once in tests.json. The related OOB Clear identity is row 1214 / variant 8e602d1b14e0686e and remains separate. The next formal queue identity was independently verified from queue, manifest and XLSX as row 1110 / variant 2a31b1237ec8e626.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G and section 33.16 assign Clear SDR Repository to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 27h. It clears all records and reinitializes the repository subsystem; it is not Delete SDR, SEL clear, Device SDR enumeration or an OEM-selected subset.

The six request bytes are Reservation ID LS/MS, ASCII C/L/R (43h/4Ch/52h), and operation AAh to initiate or 00h to obtain erasure status. The response is completion plus an erasure-progress byte whose low nibble is 0h in progress or 1h complete. Standard bytes resolve the command gap without guessing an OEM payload.

The specification states that this command is mainly a development/production aid and should generally be avoided by utilities and system-management software. That warning requires an isolated maintenance target, full evidence retention, immediate action-specific confirmation and a one-shot start policy.

Requester and reservation must match the current repository owner. The runner obtains a fresh 0Ah/22h reservation immediately before the action and proves any required modal/non-modal update state from 0Ah/20h plus target authority; reservation or mode ambiguity is NOT READY, not a reason to improvise.

A pre-clear package must contain every raw record and a canonical multiset of version/type/stable key/body, repository metadata and decoded sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control baselines. Record IDs and repository timestamps are retained as evidence but excluded from logical equality because IDs may be reassigned during reconstruction.

IPMI 2.0 section 33.13 defines Add SDR as whole-record input with a newly returned Record ID. Recovery may use 24h or, only when separately supported and validated, the reviewed 25h Partial Add path. It must restore canonical content record by record and may not assume original IDs are reusable.

The upstream ipmitool ipmi_sdradd.c implementation of sdr fill file calls its clear routine before adding records. That convenience path is prohibited for recovery because it issues a second destructive clear and can erase new evidence; the approved reconstruction runner must add into the already empty repository without re-clearing.

A file export alone is not safe recovery. Before this test is runnable, the exact artifact and no-reclear reconstruction runner must have passed an independent rehearsal on a matching isolated BMC model, firmware, repository mode and hardware population, including canonical record equality and live monitoring checks.

The empty-state oracle is erasure progress complete, repository record count zero and a bounded enumeration yielding no complete records before reconstruction. If firmware automatically repopulates or prevents observation of that state, the project must provide an authoritative quiesce/initialization contract; otherwise the case is NOT READY rather than falsely PASS.

AAh is never automatically retried. Operation 00h is a status query, not another initiation, and may be polled only within the approved bound. An uncertain transport result triggers read-only status/repository inspection and the preauthorized recovery path.

IB coverage uses the local open interface and local evidence. The OOB counterpart cannot cross-credit it, and the source boilerplate's generic log clearing is rejected because it destroys pre-action evidence.

ED-02 preserves this exact source identity; ED-03 prohibits guessed OEM behavior; ED-13 and ED-15 govern N/A and PASS criteria; ED-17 preserves evidence before deletion; ED-19 keeps IB/OOB separate; ED-28 and ED-30 require recovery ownership; ED-34 permits project parameters; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Clear SDR Repository (IB Storage 0Ah/27h) one-shot erase, empty-state proof and no-reclear rebuild
test_case.purpose: On one isolated in-band target, clear every record from the SDR Repository exactly once, prove the standard erase state machine and observable empty repository, then reconstruct the complete logical repository and monitoring behavior from an independently validated package without using OOB evidence or another clear.
required_package: Approved non-production BMC/firmware/hardware population, local IPMI open interface, maintenance window, OOB or physical safety observer and a target authority defining writable repository plus modal/non-modal update requirements
Pinned ipmitool or equivalent raw transport with exact 0Ah/20h, 22h, 23h, 24h/25h and 27h handling; credentials/privilege and local driver version recorded; no automatic retries

Immutable PRE_CLEAR_RAW export of every record plus SHA-256 manifest and canonical version/type/stable-key/body multiset, repository info and decoded sensor/threshold/event-enable/inventory/control baseline

Signed or owner-approved REBUILD_PACKAGE and no-reclear reconstruction runner that have already passed an independent matching-model/firmware/population rehearsal; each input record, expected new RID and canonical result is traceable

Explicit full-repository irreversible-action confirmation, retention/incident clearance, external thermal/power monitoring, abort/escalation path and independently usable vendor or owner recovery medium
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED FULL-REPOSITORY CLEAR; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind Source Key/variant to the local IB target and verify BMC, firmware, hardware population, repository info, update modality and maintenance isolation. Capture/hash PRE_CLEAR_RAW and canonical baselines, decoded sensors/thresholds/event enables/inventory/control behavior and SEL/OS/BMC logs without clearing them. Require a matching independent rehearsal report for the exact REBUILD_PACKAGE and a no-reclear reconstruction runner. Enter the documented update mode only if authoritative target evidence requires it. Obtain a fresh 0Ah/22h reservation R and stop on any concurrent repository change. Display that 0Ah/27h will remove all records, the exact R, baseline hash, expected zero state and recovery artifact; obtain immediate confirmation. Send once over -I open: ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x27 Rlo Rhi 0x43 0x4c 0x52 0xaa. Never resend AAh. Poll only status with the same authorized context using operation 00h at the approved interval/bound and require completion 00h plus low progress nibble 1h; preserve all intermediate output. Read 0Ah/20h and enumerate to prove count zero and no complete record. Immediately run the prevalidated no-reclear 24h/25h reconstruction, recording every returned RID, then exit update mode if applicable. Sequentially enumerate all records and require canonical equality with PRE_CLEAR_RAW, coherent repository metadata and restored sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control behavior. Keep row-1214 OOB Clear and row-1086 single Delete separate.
test_case.expected_result: One exact IB AAh initiation is accepted and status-only 00h polling reaches progress-complete within the approved bound. Before rebuild, repository info reports zero records and enumeration produces no complete SDR. The no-reclear recovery then recreates every baseline logical record; new Record IDs and timestamps may differ, but the canonical version/type/key/body multiset, record count, decoded monitoring/threshold/event/inventory/control semantics and safety observations equal baseline with no unrelated error. Missing support, automatic repopulation without an approved observation contract, ambiguous completion or unverified recovery is not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact IB identity, authoritative repository/update-mode applicability, immutable full baseline, prior matching recovery rehearsal, immediate full-scope confirmation, one and only one AAh request, bounded 00h status completion, an observable zero-record state, no-reclear reconstruction and complete canonical plus behavioral equivalence. FAIL covers a malformed/wrong-interface request, second AAh, completion without empty proof, any unreconstructed/mutated/extra record, monitoring/control loss, unexpected collateral log or recovery divergence. NOT READY covers a production/shared target, absent authoritative mode/scope, incomplete export, untested rebuild package, unavailable external safety monitoring, inability to observe the required empty state or unresolved recovery. N/A requires authoritative proof that this target has no applicable writable SDR Repository; a generic command error is insufficient.
safety_gate: Never run on production, shared or remotely unattended hardware. External thermal/power protection and an owner-controlled out-of-band or physical recovery path must remain independent of the repository being erased.
The source boilerplate's log clear is prohibited. Preserve/hash all SDRs and relevant SEL, BMC and OS evidence before the destructive action; do not delete or redact source evidence in place.

An export is not a recovery plan. Refuse execution unless the exact reconstruction package has already restored a matching isolated repository without another clear and passed canonical record plus live monitoring comparison.

Obtain a fresh reservation and exact update-mode state immediately before confirmation. Any ownership change, baseline drift, model/firmware/population mismatch or unknown OEM record aborts before AAh.

Send operation AAh once only. A timeout, disconnect or malformed response is an uncertain destructive outcome: do not retry, reset, power-cycle, delete records or use ipmitool sdr fill; use status 00h and read-only inspection, then invoke the approved recovery decision tree.

Status polling is bounded and cannot silently become initiation. Stop on reserved progress values, nonzero high nibble, unexpected completion, lost reservation or timeout and preserve the full transcript.

Require empty proof before reconstruction. If automatic firmware initialization obscures the empty state, do not reinterpret a repopulated repository as proof; use only a preapproved quiesce/agent contract or mark NOT READY.
Recovery adds records into the already empty repository and never issues a second clear. Any canonical or monitoring mismatch freezes further writes for owner/vendor recovery and makes the test FAIL.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; local IB interface, BMC/firmware/hardware population, repository info/update mode, maintenance isolation and distinct OOB/Delete identities
Immutable raw record dump and SHA-256 manifest, canonical key/body multiset, repository metadata and decoded sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control baseline
Approved rebuild artifact/runner plus prior matching rehearsal report proving no-reclear reconstruction and external recovery ownership
Fresh reservation, displayed full-scope action, baseline/rebuild hashes and immediate action-specific confirmation
The single 27h AAh request/response and every bounded 00h status sample with completion/progress interpretation; explicit proof that initiation was not retried
Zero-record repository info and bounded empty enumeration before recovery, then every Add/Partial Add input/returned RID and final sequential dump
Post-rebuild canonical equality, sensor/threshold/event/inventory/control behavior, preserved logs, final PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A and explicit statement that this review executed no DUT action
test_case.recovery: If AAh was never sent, stop without mutation. If its response is lost or ambiguous, never resend it: query 27h with operation 00h within the authorized bound and inspect repository info/enumeration read-only. Once any record is absent or erase is complete, execute the already rehearsed no-reclear reconstruction package immediately, retaining all new RIDs and comparisons. If status is indeterminate but repository content still equals baseline, quarantine the target and let the owner decide from preserved evidence; do not clear again. If reconstruction, update-mode exit or any monitoring/control comparison fails, stop all writes, maintain external safety supervision and invoke the independent owner/vendor recovery medium or replace/reprovision the isolated BMC under a separate authorization. Never hide failure with reset, power cycle, second clear, generic sdr fill or repeated Add attempts.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the all-record scope, exact 27h start/status bytes and empty-state semantics. The Review layer rejects the evidence-clearing boilerplate and supplies a traceable one-shot, rebuild-verified procedure without altering Master.

blocked.reason: The core destructive operation and a standards-based reconstruction path are defined. Exact target mode, baseline and independently rehearsed rebuild artifact are strict Project execution gates; their absence yields NOT READY and no command rather than an unresolved engineering meaning.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact isolated BMC/firmware/population and writable-repository/update-mode authority; complete raw/canonical baseline; incident/retention clearance; external safety observer; approved polling bound; independently rehearsed matching no-reclear rebuild artifact/runner; owner/vendor recovery medium and immediate confirmation.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER FULL CLEAR/REBUILD DEFINITION ONLY; NO 20H/22H/23H/24H/25H/27H COMMAND, SDR/SEL CLEAR, RESET, POWER CYCLE OR OTHER DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 33.11-33.16 and Appendix G define reservation/update behavior, Get/Add/Partial Add/Delete/Clear commands, all-record clear scope, CLR/start/status bytes, progress result and the warning that Clear should generally be avoided by utilities.

external_authorities.title: ipmitool upstream ipmi_sdradd.c
external_authorities.application: The upstream implementation demonstrates 0Ah/27h reservation plus CLR/AAh and 00h polling, and shows that sdr fill file clears the repository before adding; this is evidence for prohibiting that convenience path during recovery.

project_authority: The SDR/BMC owner binds the exact isolated platform, confirms repository update modality and automatic-initialization behavior, approves the complete baseline and independent matching recovery rehearsal, provides external safety and vendor recovery, and authorizes the one full clear. The owner cannot waive full export, empty-state evidence, no-reclear recovery, canonical/behavioral reconciliation, IB identity, one-shot initiation or no-retry rules.
